1080:     Parameters
1081:     ----------
1082:     ax : matplotlib.pyplot.axes
1083:         The axes handle to apply the ticker.
1084:         By default, uses the current axes handle.
1085: 
1086:     """
1087:     ax, _ = __get_axes(ax=ax)
1088: 
1089:     ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(FMT_MIDI_NOTE)
1090:     # Get the tick labels and reset the vertical alignment
1091:     for tick in ax.yaxis.get_ticklabels():
1092:         tick.set_verticalalignment("baseline")
1093: 
1094: 
1095: def ticker_pitch(ax=None):
1096:     """Set the y-axis of the given axes to MIDI frequencies
1097: 
1098:     Parameters
1099:     ----------
1100:     ax : matplotlib.pyplot.axes
1101:         The axes handle to apply the ticker.
1102:         By default, uses the current axes handle.
1103:     """
1104:     ax, _ = __get_axes(ax=ax)
1105: 
1106:     ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(FMT_MIDI_HZ)
1107: 
1108: 
1109: # Instantiate ticker objects; we don't need more than one of each
1110: FMT_MIDI_NOTE = FuncFormatter(__ticker_midi_note)
1111: FMT_MIDI_HZ = FuncFormatter(__ticker_midi_hz)
1112: 
1113: 
1114: # Hatch patterns for chord displays
1115: __CHORD_HATCHES__ = {
1116:     "maj": "",
1117:     "min": "",
1118:     "sus4": "||",
1119:     "sus2": "--",
1120:     "aug": "++",
1121:     "dim": "..",
1122:     "maj7": "//",
1123:     "minmaj7": "//",
1124:     "7": r"\\",
1125:     "min7": r"\\",
1126:     "hdim7": ".//",
1127:     "dim7": r".\\",
1128:     "maj6": "xx",
1129:     "min6": "xx",
1130: }
1131: 
1132: 
1133: def _quality_to_majminoth(q):
1134: 
1135:     if q[3] and not q[4]:
1136:         # a b3 and no natural 3
1137:         return "min"
1138: 
1139:     elif q[4] and not q[3]:
1140:         # a natural 3 and no flat 3
1141:         return "maj"
1142:     else:
1143:         # Anything else is 'other'
1144:         return "other"
1145: 
1146: 
1147: def __chord_to_color(chord, major, minor, other):
1148: 
1149:     root, quality, bass = encode_chord(chord, reduce_extended_chords=True)
1150:     ctype = _quality_to_majminoth(quality)
1151: 
1152:     if ctype == "maj" or "sus" in chord:
1153:         return major(root)
1154:     elif ctype == "min":
1155:         return minor(root)
1156:     else:
1157:         return other(root)
1158: 
1159: 
1160: def chords(
1161:     intervals,
1162:     labels,
1163:     base=None,
1164:     height=None,
1165:     text=False,
1166:     text_kw=None,
1167:     ax=None,
1168:     cmap="fifths",
1169:     pattern=True,
1170:     **kwargs,
1171: ):
1172:     """Plot a chord annotation as a set of disjoint rectangles with semantically meaningful colors.
1173: 
1174:     Parameters
1175:     ----------
1176:     intervals : np.ndarray, shape=(n, 2)
1177:         segment intervals, in the format returned by
1178:         :func:`mir_eval.io.load_intervals` or
1179:         :func:`mir_eval.io.load_labeled_intervals`.
1180:     labels : list, shape=(n,)
1181:         reference chord labels, in the format returned by
1182:         :func:`mir_eval.io.load_labeled_intervals`.
1183:     base : number
1184:         The vertical position of the base of the rectangles.
1185:         By default, this will be the bottom of the plot.
1186:     height : number
1187:         The height of the rectangles.
1188:         By default, this will be the top of the plot (minus ``base``).
1189:         .. note:: If either `base` or `height` are provided, both must be provided.
1190:     text : bool
1191:         If true, each segment's label is displayed in its
1192:         upper-left corner
1193:     text_kw : dict
1194:         If ``text == True``, the properties of the text
1195:         object can be specified here.
1196:         See ``matplotlib.pyplot.Text`` for valid parameters
1197:     ax : matplotlib.pyplot.axes
1198:         An axis handle on which to draw the segmentation.
1199:         If none is provided, a new set of axes is created.
1200:     cmap : {'pitch', 'fifths'}
1201:         The color map to use for the chord display.
1202:         If 'pitch', the colors will cycle chromatically (C, C#, D, ...)
1203:         If 'fifths', the colors will cycle through the circle of fifths (C, G, D, ...).
1204:         In both cases, major qualities (identified by a natural third) and suspended chords (sus2, sus4)
1205:         will receive a bright color, and minor qualities (identified by a flat third) will receive a
1206:         darker color.
1207:         Other Qualities which are neither major nor minor will receive a light color.
1208:         No-chord ('N') or out-of-gamut ('X') symbols will be colored gray.
1209:     pattern : bool
1210:         If `True`, segments will be filled with a hatch pattern
1211:         corresponding to the chord quality as described below:
1212:         - Major: no hatch
1213:         - Minor: no hatch
1214:         - Suspended 2nd: horizontal hatch
1215:         - Suspended 4th: vertical hatch
1216:         - Augmented: cross hatch
1217:         - Diminished: dot hatch
1218:         - Major 7th: forward slash hatch
1219:         - Minor Major 7th: forward slash hatch
1220:         - Dominant 7th: backward slash hatch
1221:         - Minor 7th: backward slash hatch
1222:         - Half-diminished 7th: dot and forward slash hatch
1223:         - Diminished 7th: dot and backward slash hatch
1224:         - Major 6th: cross hatch
1225:         - Minor 6th: cross hatch
1226:     **kwargs
1227:         Additional keyword arguments to pass to
1228:         ``matplotlib.axes.Axes.axvspan``.
1229: 
1230:     Returns
1231:     -------
1232:     ax : matplotlib.pyplot.axes._subplots.AxesSubplot
1233:         A handle to the (possibly constructed) plot axes
1234:     """
1235:     if cmap == "fifths":
